In mathematics, '''Denisyuk polynomials''' De<sub>''n''</sub>(''x'') or ''M''<sub>''n''</sub>(''x'') are generalizations of the [[Laguerre polynomials]] introduced by {{harvtxt|Denisyuk|1954}} given by the [[generating function]]{{sfnp|Boas|Buck|1958|p=41}}

<math display="block">\displaystyle \sum_{n=0}^\infty t^nM_n(x)=\frac 1{1+t}\exp\left(-\frac{xt}{1-t}\right).</math>
